'''Voteb''' was a remote settlement that was located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ventured to Lanteeb on a mission to counter the development of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Damotite bioweapon|bioweapon]], and while on the world the pair disguised themselves as natives from Voteb.
